chapters.title: A Charter and a Hearth
chapters.intro: Every crown began as a fire in a field. Plant your charter and gather people round it.

steps.title: Plant the Charter
steps.flavour: A banner, a chest and a claim on the land.
steps.objective: Found a settlement with a Town Charter

steps.title: A Hall for Every Voice
steps.flavour: Where there is a hall, there is a town.
steps.objective: Finish a Town Hall

steps.title: Roofs Over Heads
steps.flavour: Settlers stay where the rain stays out.
steps.objective: Have 4 finished buildings in one town

steps.title: Sworn Swords
steps.flavour: A fire draws travellers, and not all of them are friendly.
steps.objective: Have 3 soldiers in your garrisons

steps.title: No Longer a Camp
steps.flavour: The carters have started calling it by name.
steps.objective: Raise a town to Hamlet rank

chapters.title: Stone and Scholarship
chapters.intro: Wood burns and memory fades. Build in stone and write things down.

steps.title: Ink and Candle
steps.flavour: Someone must remember how the last well was dug.
steps.objective: Finish a Library

steps.title: Learned Folk
steps.flavour: Three ideas, argued over and written down.
steps.objective: Complete 3 research projects in one town

steps.title: Dressed Stone
steps.flavour: Square blocks, true walls, proud gables.
steps.objective: Research Masonry

steps.title: A Helping Hand
steps.flavour: A lord who carries stone is a lord who is followed.
steps.objective: Complete a town bounty (Quests page)

steps.title: A Proper Village
steps.flavour: A market day, a priest, a quarrel over a fence.
steps.objective: Raise a town to Village rank

chapters.title: Walls and Watchmen
chapters.intro: Wealth draws raiders as honey draws wasps. Wall the town and drill the guard.

steps.title: The Art of Defence
steps.flavour: Learn from the castles of older kings.
steps.objective: Research Fortifications

steps.title: Raise the Walls
steps.flavour: Three blocks thick, five high, and a walk on top.
steps.objective: Finish 4 wall sections, towers or gatehouses

steps.title: A Standing Guard
steps.flavour: Eight spears on the wall, eight more asleep.
steps.objective: Have 8 soldiers in your garrisons

steps.title: Clear the Roads
steps.flavour: Merchants come where the roads are safe.
steps.objective: Slay 20 hostile mobs (you or your soldiers)

steps.title: Hold the Gate
steps.flavour: They came at dusk. They did not get in.
steps.objective: Hold off a raid on one of your cities (or take a city yourself)

steps.title: Market Charter
steps.flavour: A town, by right and by charter.
steps.objective: Raise a town to Town rank

chapters.title: The Realm Widens
chapters.intro: One town is a lordship. Two is a realm. Settle, march and treat with your neighbours.

steps.title: A Second Hearth
steps.flavour: Your banner flies over two market squares.
steps.objective: Rule 2 cities (found or conquer one)

steps.title: Banners on the March
steps.flavour: Win or lose, the realm learns its strength.
steps.objective: Lead a raid on a rival city

steps.title: The Pen and the Sword
steps.flavour: A treaty signed is a war you need not fight.
steps.objective: Agree a truce or tribute with another kingdom (Kingdom page)

steps.title: A Sworn Shield
steps.flavour: One soldier who follows you, not the town.
steps.objective: Promote a Royal Guard

steps.title: City of Stone
steps.flavour: Two walls, a guildhall and a bishop's opinion.
steps.objective: Raise a town to City rank

chapters.title: The Crown
chapters.intro: A capital, a castle and a crown. Make the realm a kingdom.

steps.title: The Royal Charter
steps.flavour: Ink and wax make a king as surely as steel.
steps.objective: Research Royal Charter

steps.title: Seat of the Realm
steps.flavour: All roads lead here now.
steps.objective: Raise your capital to Capital rank

steps.title: A Castle for a King
steps.flavour: Four towers, a great hall and a courtyard for the court.
steps.objective: Finish the Capital Castle

steps.title: Three Banners
steps.flavour: A kingdom is more than its capital.
steps.objective: Rule 3 cities

steps.title: Long Live the King
steps.flavour: Kneel a lord. Rise a king.
steps.objective: Take a rival kingdom's capital, or rule 5 cities
